newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya coffee prices rise on demand at auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya coffee prices rise on demand at auction.

text.p: Kenyan coffee prices gained about $40 at the weekly auction in Nairobi under heavy buying pressure amid declining good quality volumes, auction officials said on Tuesday.
Premium grade ABs averaged $350 per 50-kg compared to $308 last week, while grade AAs averaged $351 from $317. Grade Cs averaged $331 from $284.
The Coffee Board of Kenya said it sold 35,697 60-kg bags compared to 35,738 bags sold last week.
